title: ODS Dataset Provenance
description: Unified provenance document identifying the source TRUD archive and tool build identity for an ods dataset release. Provenance records where data came from and what built it; the dataset descriptor (datapackage.json) records what it is and its version. A published dataset's _provenance.json always carries the fields enforced by ods's publish checks (validate_publishable and perform_all_release_checks): trud_release_date, trud_release_sha256, trud_release_sha256_verified (not unverified), trud_release_filesize_bytes, tool_version, tool_git_sha, and tool_git_dirty, verified by ods's own checks as the authority; all other fields are optional.
$comment: Build-run facts such as runner machine identifiers, execution timestamps, job IDs, and build environment details are intentionally excluded from this document so rebuilds reproduce byte-identical datasets and identical manifest digests. dataset_version belongs in datapackage.json (Frictionless version field) rather than provenance so that relabelling or re-tagging a release produces byte-identical provenance. Build-run facts belong in an external SLSA provenance attestation accompanying the release.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema describing this provenance document format.

trud_release_date.description: The release date of the source archive on NHS TRUD in YYYY-MM-DD format. Extracted from TRUD release metadata; recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_sha256.description: Upper-case 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the TRUD source archive ZIP file. Computed and recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_sha256_verified.description: Method used to verify the TRUD release archive SHA-256 hash: 'trud_api' if verified directly against NHS England's authenticated TRUD API, 'published_release' if verified against a previously published trusted release, or 'unverified' if the archive was provided locally without API verification. Recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_filesize_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the source TRUD ZIP archive file, greater than zero. Measured and recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_schema_version.description: The schema version declared in the <Version> attribute of the source XML manifest in the TRUD archive (e.g. '2-0-0'). Recorded by ods make.

tool_version.description: Semantic version string (SemVer) of the ods CLI tool that built this release. Recorded by ods make.

tool_git_sha.description: Lower-case 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA of the ods tool repository at build time. Recorded by ods make.

tool_git_dirty.description: Boolean flag indicating whether uncommitted working tree changes were present when the ods tool binary was compiled. Recorded by ods make.
